verdict.rationale: Glama runs a very large catalog of MCP servers and remote connectors: llms.txt lists 91,626 servers and 23,749 connectors, and the docs say users can "search, compare, and connect to thousands of MCP servers." Any registry server can be deployed to Glama behind its Gateway, so developers reach these third-party integrations through the platform itself. A community comment about getting "lost in the sea of existing ones" corroborates the catalog's size. Missing for 10: independent hands-on evidence that catalog integrations work reliably when reached through Glama, and documentation of how many entries are vetted versus community-submitted.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reach a deep catalog of third-party apps and APIs (hundreds to thousands of integrations) through the platform
